page_title: JUV 0-0 ACM | Juventus v AC Milan 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Weston McKennie (Juventus) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
90+1' Michele Di Gregorio pulls off a great save to deny Rafael Leao (AC Milan), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Filip Kostic (Juventus) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

89' Filip Kostic (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
88' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
86' Today's match ends for Daniele Rugani who will be replaced by Filip Kostic (Juventus).
85' Weston McKennie (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
84' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Juventus, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' Juventus keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
76' Lois Openda (Juventus) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
74' Federico Gatti (Juventus) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) will replace Christian Pulisic.
73' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His effort goes inches wide of the left post.
72' Marco Guida has a clear sight and sees a foul from Federico Gatti (Juventus).
68' The referee signals a substitution. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Jonathan David.
68' Igor Tudor decides to make a substitution. Kenan Yildiz will be replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
68' Lois Openda (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Francisco Conceicao.
68' Wasted effort! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
67' A quickly taken corner by Juventus.
67' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.
66' Dangerous play by Federico Gatti (Juventus). Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.
64' Juventus hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
63' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Youssouf Fofana and he is replaced by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
63' Substitution. Rafael Leao (AC Milan) on for Santiago Tomas Gimenez.
61' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
59' Yellow card. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
58' Some neat passing and movement from AC Milan as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
57' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
54' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly over the crossbar.
53' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
53' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece. That's a penalty to AC Milan! They have a good chance to score now.
52' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
49' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

48' Federico Gatti (Juventus) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom left corner. His promising effort is kept out by Mike Maignan, who pulls off a stunning save!
48' Juventus take a short corner kick.
48' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus). The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Guida starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Mike Maignan (AC Milan).

45+1' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Juventus.
45+1' Juventus work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
44' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Pierre Kalulu (Juventus), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the left post.
41' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
40' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Luka Modric (AC Milan) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
36' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Guida no option but to blow his whistle.
35' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) blazes well wide of the right post.

33' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Michele Di Gregorio.
31' Marco Guida blows his whistle. Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) commits a foul after dangerous play.
30' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
30' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
28' Some patient build-up play from Juventus as they look to unlock the defence.

25' Federico Gatti (Juventus) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is aimed towards the middle of the net, but Mike Maignan pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
24' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Guida interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
23' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
23' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
19' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
17' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts the ball.
16' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) and Luka Modric combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
12' Weston McKennie (Juventus) commits a rough foul. Marco Guida stops the game and makes a call.
11' Some great controlled play and passing from Juventus. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
6' Luka Modric (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Michele Di Gregorio punches the ball away.
6' The AC Milan players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
3' An attempted cross from Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is cleared.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
AC Milan will kick the game off.
Marco Guida is the one to supervise the game today.
